class.name: Context
class.brief_description: Unified access point for Application-wide services.
class.description:
Android-style Context. All game_framework components that need access to shared services (Activity, Dialog, Application) go through a Context. The Context delegates to the managers owned by [Application].
Context also provides static shortcuts for [BindingEngine] (MVVM) and [Toast] factory.
Most users interact with Context through [Activity] or [Dialog] convenience methods, or by calling [code]get_context().xxx()[/code] directly.

method.name: back
method.description: Triggers the system back gesture. Calls [method Activity._on_back_pressed] on the top Activity; if not consumed, finishes it. Returns [code]false[/code] if the stack is empty.

method.name: bind
method.description: Scans [param view] node's [code]"bindings"[/code] / [code]"commands"[/code] metadata and calls [method bind_property] / [method bind_command] accordingly. Delegates to [BindingEngine].

method.name: bind_command
method.description: Binds a signal on [param source] to a method on [param vm]. Delegates to [BindingEngine].

method.name: bind_property
method.description: Binds [param source_property] on [param vm] to [param target_property] on [param target]. Changes to the ViewModel property are pushed to the target node. Delegates to [BindingEngine].

method.name: dismiss_dialog
method.description: Dismisses a specific [Dialog].

method.name: finish_activity
method.description: Finishes (destroys) a specific [Activity]. Called internally by [method Activity.finish].

method.name: finish_top
method.description: Finishes the current top Activity. Equivalent to [code]ActivityManager.finish_top()[/code].

method.name: get_application
method.description: Returns the [Application] this Context belongs to.

method.name: get_current_activity
method.description: Returns the current top Activity, or [code]null[/code] if the stack is empty.

method.name: get_resource_handle
method.description: Returns a [ResourceHandle] for the given path, creating one if needed. The handle tracks loading state.

method.name: get_service
method.description: Looks up a service by name from the [ServiceRegistry]. Returns [code]null[/code] if not found.

method.name: get_stack_size
method.description: Returns the number of Activities in the back stack.

method.name: has_service
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a service with the given name is registered.

method.name: load_resource_async
method.description: Asynchronously loads a resource. On platforms without threads (single-threaded Web export) falls back to synchronous load.

method.name: load_resource_sync
method.description: Synchronously loads a resource and returns it immediately.

method.name: make_toast
method.description: Creates a new plain-text [Toast]. Equivalent to [code]Toast.make_text(text, duration)[/code].

method.name: register_activity
method.description: Registers an Activity scene for the given action string. Delegates to [method ActivityManager.register_activity].

method.name: show_dialog
method.description: Shows a Dialog. The Dialog's lifecycle owner defaults to the current top Activity.

method.name: show_dialog_with_owner
method.description: Shows a Dialog with an explicit lifecycle owner. The Dialog is auto-dismissed when [param owner] is destroyed.

method.name: show_toast
method.description: Enqueues a Toast for display. The Toast's lifecycle owner defaults to the current top Activity.

method.name: show_toast_with_owner
method.description: Enqueues a Toast with an explicit lifecycle owner. The Toast is removed from the queue when [param owner] is destroyed.

method.name: start_activity
method.description: Starts a new Activity based on [param intent].action. Delegates to [method ActivityManager.start_activity].
